Reference1 is the authoritative full-card ACE OF SPADES: preserve its EXACT 1060x1484 (5:7) canvas, ivory margins, thin gold/ivory lotus-vine outer frame, two opposing ivory index cartouches, dense BLACK interior floral fields, scalloped gold-outlined ivory reserve and delicate pale-gold floral tracery at its edges. Reference2 is the existing suit PIP ASSET: faithfully adapt this pip's silhouette, gold beaded outline, curling teal foliage, ivory/red lotuses, large central rosette and turquoise jewel. Do not invent a different pip style.
Remove reference1's central spade completely and replace it with ONE large upright emblem of the specified suit, naturally proportioned as reference2, centered horizontally with its turquoise jewel at the exact canvas center. Keep a clear ivory gap around every edge of the emblem. Large lavish emblem occupying most of available central width, about60% of total card width. Rich suit-colored ground remains visible between internal botanical details. Preserve the reference1's fine printed illustration shading and detail. No people, clothing, weapons, sash or separate central jewel.
Only two corner indices, each a large serif A above a small solid suit symbol. Upper-left upright, lower-right same index rotated180degrees. Single central emblem upright, NOT doubled into opposing symbols. No other text, logo, tax stamp, ribbon, signature, watermark or mockup. Deliver ONE full card on the same EXACT 1060 pixels WIDE by1484 pixels HIGH canvas as reference1, aspect5:7, NOT1042x1510. SPECIFIC SUIT DIAMONDS. ONE MADDER RED DIAMOND, a tall rhombus with FOUR STRAIGHT SIDES and four sharp points, top/bottom/left/right. No curves, heart lobes, club lobes or spade stem. Use reference2's red diamond with its gold-beaded border, teal foliage, red/ivory lotus rosette and turquoise jewel. Enlarge the diamond to fill most of available ivory area while maintaining reference2's tall proportions, approximately55% of total card width and55% of card height. Center turquoise jewel at full canvas center. Both A letters and small corner DIAMOND symbols are RED. Change ONLY outermost frame band from black to deep Madder Lake red with same ivory/gold vines; interior floral corner fields remain BLACK. Keep all frame boundaries and cartouche positions unchanged.
